title: Component formula for extension by zero
statement: For every scheme X and open U, writing L for the sheafification of the extension-by-zero presheaf functor on modules, there exists an adjunction adj : L ⊣ overFunctor (the restriction functor) such that, for every F, G, morphism ψ : L.obj F ⟶ G, open V and map h : V ⟶ U, and section s of F over h, the adjunction hom-equivalence evaluated at h and s equals the sheafification Hom-equivalence applied to ψ and the direct-sum injection of s into the h-summand.

proof.text: Use the explicit direct-sum presheaf of def-weil-extension-by-zero-presheaf. Its restriction on a summand is computed using DirectSum.toAddMonoid_of. Restrict a presheaf morphism to each canonical injection to construct a sheaf-module morphism on Over U; its naturality is presheaf-morphism naturality and Over.w.

Conversely, apply DirectSum.toModule to the components of a morphism on Over U. Naturality is checked by DirectSum.induction_on, using the restriction formula and the given morphism naturality. DirectSum.toModule.unique and DirectSum.toModule_lof prove the two inverse identities. Right naturality is componentwise reflexivity; left naturality follows on injections from DirectSum.lmap_of.

Compose this natural Hom equivalence with Mathlib PresheafOfModules.sheafificationHomEquiv. The naturality identities of PresheafOfModules.sheafificationAdjunction supply the remaining naturality, so Adjunction.mkOfHomEquiv constructs the adjunction.

Specialize to the structure ring sheaf of X. Rewrite Adjunction.mkOfHomEquiv_homEquiv and the forward map, and evaluate the linear-map composite with DirectSum.lof_eq_of. The only residual difference is the DecidableEq instance on V → U; Subsingleton.elim identifies these instances.

proof_origin.place: Definition 00A4 and Lemma 00A7 (2); adapts the private Hom-equivalence construction from Sheaf.CategoryTheory.LocalizedModuleAdjunctionExact, inlining the direct-sum restriction and naturality calculations locally

lean.statement:
theorem module_extensionByZero_hom_formula (X : Scheme.{u}) (U : X.Opens) :
    let R := X.ringCatSheaf
    let P := SheafOfModules.extensionByZeroPresheaf.{u} R U
    let L := P ⋙ PresheafOfModules.sheafification (𝟙 R.obj)
    ∃ adj : L ⊣ SheafOfModules.overFunctor R U,
        (∀ (F : SheafOfModules.{u} (R.over U)) (G : X.Modules)
          (ψ : L.obj F ⟶ G) (V : X.Opens) (h : V ⟶ U)
          (s : F.val.obj (op (Over.mk h))),
          ((adj.homEquiv F G ψ).val.app (op (Over.mk h))) s =
            (PresheafOfModules.sheafificationHomEquiv (𝟙 R.obj) ψ).app (op V)
              (DirectSum.of (fun φ : V ⟶ U => F.val.obj (op (Over.mk φ))) h s))
